messages:
oliver: Heads-up — code freeze for v2.3.0 starts in ~18h. No non-trivial merges after cutoff unless approved exception. Ping here with exception requests. :alarm_clock:
marta: quick q — my PR is just docs (changelog tweak + wording). do I need an exception?
oliver: docs-only ok if it's a one-file changelog or README tweak and CI green. keep it <5 min review. :+1:
sanjay: FYI my PR updates runtime config parsing (small refactor) and touches nginx proxy header. requested exception — risk: may affect deployments. details: PR #5012, diff is ~120 lines.
jen: marking for review. can we run the perf + integration job on that PR? if it passes I'm +1 for exception.
emma: if it's config, prefer feature-flag + canary deploy plan. also bump the changelog entry under "Runtime" and add rollback steps.
rio: tagging reviewers: @eng-releases @eng-runtime. can someone triage review ETA?
deploy-bot: AUTO: freeze_countdown set for release v2.3.0 — cutoff at 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Exceptions require triage and 2 reviewers.
qa-bot: note: recent e2e suite had intermittent failure on session-reconnect on main. if your change touches networking, please run `./scripts/e2e --focus session-reconnect` locally.
oliver: Exception triage criteria (apply before cutoff):
```
- PR size: ideally < 300 lines changed
- Scope: bugfix, docs, rollbackable config toggle allowed
- Tests: unit + affected e2e passing (local or CI screenshot)
- Rollback plan: explicit commands and timeline
- Owner on-call: owner must be available for 24h post-merge
- Reviewers: 2 approvals including at least one runtime reviewer
```
oliver: If you meet these, paste a short justification + checklist here and I'll rubber-stamp. We won't approve schema or model changes in freeze window.
sanjay: submitting checklist now: PR 5012 — size 120, scope: config refactor (bugfix), tests: unit+e2e local pass, rollback: `git revert` documented, owner: @sanjay available, reviewers: @jen + @emma.
jen: reviewed + ran perf job: no regression observed. approving.
emma: approved assuming canary flag rollout. added changelog entry.
oliver: OK — exception approved. please merge with `git merge --no-ff` and note revert SHA in the release notes.
marta: merged docs PR 5009 — thanks.
rio: quick reminder for everyone: bump the `CHANGELOG.md` section header to v2.3.0 and add 1-line entries, ops will compile release notes from that.
oliver: final note: if anything lands after cutoff without explicit approval it'll be reverted. keep us posted in this thread. :white_check_mark:
